items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-07-01
items.q: Dave Payton was a crackerjack. In those days he was a cracker.

ctx.x: He's teaching music now. I guess he gave up playing the violin.
He was a nice violinist. Nice violinist and he played at the Vendome Theatre. Dave Payton was a crackerjack. In those days he was a cracker.
Who were some outstanding piano players around Chicago?
